:::{#thm-exp-surv}

#### Survival function of the exponential distribution

If $T$ has an [exponential distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-exponential) with rate $\lambda > 0$,
then for $t \ge 0$:

$$\surv(t) = e^{-\lambda t}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-review-exp-dist.

:::
